description: The G1 humanoid navigates from a start pose to a goal while avoiding collisions AND staying upright (not falling). Extends the wheeled-robot navigation spec with humanoid balance: an 'upright' invariant and a 'fell_over' safety failure mode. APs are all rule-based over the sensor schema (odometry + laser + Nav2 status + base pose).

atomic_propositions.target_received: True when distance_to_target > 100.0. A target location has been set for navigation.
atomic_propositions.path_planned: True when nav_status == 'accepted'. Nav2 accepted the path plan.
atomic_propositions.moving_towards_target: True when nav_status == 'executing'. The robot is executing the planned path.
atomic_propositions.collision_risk: True when min_range < 0.25. An obstacle is too close to the robot.
atomic_propositions.target_reached: True when distance_to_target < 0.5. The robot is within close proximity of the goal.
atomic_propositions.navigation_succeeded: True when nav_status == 'succeeded'. The navigation goal was achieved.
atomic_propositions.navigation_failed: True when nav_status in ['aborted', 'canceled']. Navigation was interrupted or failed.
atomic_propositions.upright: True when upright_flag > 0.5. The G1 base is level and standing (not fallen).

named_failure_modes.name: collision_imminent
named_failure_modes.description: The robot must never enter a state where an obstacle is too close.

named_failure_modes.name: fell_over
named_failure_modes.description: The G1 must never fall — the base must stay level and above the fallen-height threshold throughout.

execution_phases.description: The robot receives the target and Nav2 plans a path.
The G1 walks towards the target, staying upright and clear of obstacles.

terminal_success.description: The mission is accomplished when Nav2 reports success (and the robot never fell/collided).

terminal_failure.description: The mission failed if navigation was aborted or canceled.
